question: Which river basin originates from the Western Ghats range of Karnataka state and has many tributaries such as the Noyyal, Kabini, Arkavathi and Amaravati?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kaveri.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The river basin that originates from the** Western Ghats** range of **Karnataka state** is the Kaveri River Basin.
 
• The Kaveri River Basin is one of the major river basins in India and covers parts of **Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, and Kerala.**
 
• The** Noyyal, Kabini, Arkavathi, and Amaravati** are some of the important tributaries of the Kaveri River.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sabarmati** flows westward in India.

 
 
• **It starts in the Aravalli Range in the Udaipur District of Rajasthan and travels 371 km in a south-westerly direction throughout Rajasthan and Gujarat before meeting the Gulf of Khambhat of the Arabian Sea.**
 
 
 
• In eastern India's state of **Odisha**, there is a significant seasonal river called the **Brahmani**.
 
 
• **The Brahmani river travels through the districts of Sundargarh, Deogarh, Angul, Dhenkanal, Cuttack, Jajapur, and Kendrapara.**
 
• It is produced by the confluence of the Sankh and South Koel rivers.
 
 
 
• Periyar is a longest river in Kerala having large discharge potential.
 
 
• **It is one of the few rivers that flows year-round in the area and supplies drinking water to a number of sizable communities.**
